impact.text: The staking limit check does not account for slashed funds, which means the protocol may prevent new stakes even though the actual amount of HYPE in the system (after accounting for slashing) is below the staking limit.

precondition_sources.text: Slashed funds exist in the protocol, reducing the actual amount of HYPE in the system below the staking limit.
A new stake is submitted to the stake() function of StakingManager.sol.

intent_sources.text: The staking limit must be enforced based on the actual amount of funds in the system, accounting for both rewards and slashing.
